description: Canonical tool-name mapping for the agentii-investment-intelligence package. Maps legacy prompt tool names and upstream FSI MCP connector references to spec-019 endpoint names. Also documents citation rewrite rules (FR-050) and preflight health-check templates.

system_v2_7._comment: Maps tool names used in references/prompts/system_v2_7.py (the well-tested agentic long-range financial analysis prompt set) to spec-019 endpoint names that agentii-ai/apps/api/ exposes.

upstream_fsi._comment: Maps upstream Daloopa/FactSet/S&P Global/Bloomberg/LSEG MCP connector tool references (used in anthropics/financial-services) to agentii equivalents backed by spec-019.

citation_rewrite_rules._comment: Regex-based rewrites to convert upstream citation formats to the FR-050 v1.0 frozen format: [📄 <ticker> <form> p.<page>](agentii://source/<uuid>?accession=<accession>&page=<page>). The canonical format is validated by scripts/validate-citations.py.

rules.name: daloopa_source_n
rules.note: Daloopa citation format has no direct agentii equivalent without filing context. Port script must reconstruct the citation by joining the upstream source row to an agentii source UUID.

rules.name: factset_bare
rules.note: FactSet references lack enough metadata to construct an FR-050 citation. Port must fail loud.

rules.name: legacy_tuple_row
rules.note: Legacy tuple-row syntax is deprecated; must be expanded to full FR-050 form.

preflight_templates._comment: Reusable MCP health-check snippets for ## Preflight sections in SKILL.md. Both must complete in <2s.
